title: Family Wilderness Adventure 7-Day Safari
summary: Embark on a 7-day family safari in Tanzania, exploring Arusha's lush landscapes, the iconic Serengeti, and tranquil Tarangire National Park. Tailored for families, this journey offers thrilling wildlife encounters, cultural experiences, and unforgettable adventures suitable for all ages.
description: Embark on an unforgettable seven-day family safari through Tanzania, crafted to captivate adventurers of all ages. From the towering baobabs of Tarangire to the shimmering waters of Lake Manyara, the journey weaves through Tanzania's most enchanting landscapes, creating memories that will last a lifetime. Witness the boundless plains of the Serengeti, teeming with incredible wildlife, and marvel at the Ngorongoro Crater, a natural wonder and cradle of diversity. This expertly curated itinerary ensures thrilling wildlife encounters, enriching cultural experiences, and the perfect blend of adventure and relaxation for the whole family. Whether you're watching elephants stroll by at sunset or spotting the Big Five with wide-eyed excitement, this safari promises a magical journey into Africa’s natural splendor.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description:
Your adventure begins at the airport, where you'll be greeted with a warm smile by your Mazingira Safari private guide. An expert on all things Tanzania, he will lead you to your first lodge in Arusha, setting the tone for your family-friendly safari. Spend the day relaxing and soaking in the atmosphere, as you anticipate the thrilling days ahead. If you arrive early and want to jump right into the excitement, consider one of the optional activities available in Arusha for an extra fee:
- Explore the vibrant city on a guided tour
- Saddle up for an exhilarating horse ride
- Stretch into relaxation with yoga classes
- Immerse yourself in local culture with a cultural tour
- Canoe or hike around serene Lake Duluti
- Indulge in a flavorful coffee tour
- Set out on a day trip to Arusha National Park
No matter your choice, the journey begins here, promising unforgettable experiences for your entire family.
itinerary.destination_note: Arusha is known as the safari capital of Tanzania's Northern Safari Circuit.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.description:
After a delightful breakfast, your safari guide will pick you up around 8:00 a.m. and whisk you away to Tarangire National Park, a two-hour drive from Arusha. Named after the Tarangire River that winds through it, this lush sanctuary becomes the region's sole water source during the dry season. Amid dense vegetation and towering baobabs, you'll find massive herds of elephants—sometimes up to 300—gathered near the riverbanks, drinking or wallowing in cooling mud baths.
Tarangire's vast landscape is a haven for wildlife enthusiasts, offering glimpses of graceful giraffes, hippos, baboons, and big cats. Unique to the park are its tree-climbing lions and elusive rock pythons, adding extra layers of intrigue to this picturesque wilderness. As you explore its grasslands, swamps, and floodplains, marvel at the park's spectacular diversity and the magical moments unfolding before your eyes.
itinerary.destination_note: Tarangire National Park Famous for its large elephant herds

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara & Maasai Boma Visit
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, embark on an early journey across the Great Rift Valley to Lake Manyara National Park. Though compact at 205 square miles, this park offers an array of stunning landscapes. Marvel at the lush acacia forests, giant fig trees, and mahogany canopies that shelter playful baboons and blue monkeys. As you explore, you'll encounter giraffes, elephants, impalas, and herds of buffaloes, while the lake itself is home to large numbers of hippos.
The game drives offer incredible photo opportunities, capturing giraffes and buffaloes set against the shimmering lake. After lunch, immerse yourself in the vibrant Maasai culture with a visit to a traditional Maasai boma. Learn about their marriage customs, culinary practices, and familial roles, and gain insights into their traditional medicine and fire-making techniques. End the visit with a lively Maasai dance before retiring to your lodge for a relaxed evening, dinner, and overnight stay.
itinerary.destination_note: Lake Manyara National Park well known for the tree climbing lions, the soda ash lake that attracts thousands and pink flamingos

itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park with Optional Balloon Safari
itinerary.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey to Serengeti National Park, where the "endless plains" (Siringet in Maasai) stretch before you, teeming with unparalleled wildlife. Over these two days, explore the central Serengeti, where year-round game viewing reveals a diverse tapestry of animals. Elephant, giraffe, impala, waterbuck, hippo, reedbuck, buffalo, and baboon are permanent residents of these lands, even after the great herds of wildebeest and zebra have moved on.
After exhilarating game drives, return to your lodge for dinner and overnight relaxation, reflecting on the day's thrilling encounters. For a unique perspective, consider adding a balloon safari to your adventure, soaring above the plains at sunrise and witnessing herds of wildlife from the skies. This awe-inspiring experience will offer a fresh and mesmerising view of the Serengeti’s vast beauty.
itinerary.destination_note: Serengeti National Park Famous for being the location of the Great Wildlife Migration Optional ExtraBalloon Safari

itinerary.title: Serengeti - Ngorongoro Conservancy
itinerary.description:
Start your day with a hearty breakfast at your lodge before setting out for another exciting game drive in Serengeti National Park. Your experienced safari guide will carefully select the prime spots for wildlife viewing, ensuring the best sightings. Spend time by the hippo pool, where these mighty creatures laze contentedly in the cool water, often sharing their space with crocodiles.
After soaking in the unique sights and sounds of this vibrant ecosystem, make your way to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area for an overnight stay. Here, you'll rest amid breathtaking landscapes, eager for more thrilling encounters with nature's wonders on your final day.
itinerary.destination_note: Serengeti National Park is a World Heritage Site teeming with wildlife Spot the hippo's in the cool pools of the Seregenti

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description:
Rise early for breakfast, then settle into your private safari vehicle for a scenic journey through the Great Rift Valley and crater forest, culminating at the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater. As one of Africa's Seven Natural Wonders and its most-visited destination, the crater is home to an unmatched concentration of wildlife, including elephants, lions, buffaloes, hippos, and the elusive black rhino. Beyond game viewing, Ngorongoro offers fascinating cultural and historical experiences, from traditional Maasai villages to the ancient Laetoli footprints, the oldest known traces of early humans dating back 3.5 million years.
After a day filled with incredible wildlife sightings and historical exploration, return to Arusha for your airport transfer, heading back home or onward to Zanzibar for a well-deserved tropical extension.
itinerary.destination_note: Ngorongoro Crater The world's biggest intact volcanic caldera, the Ngorongoro Crater, is located in Tanzania-Ngorongoro near Serengeti national park.
